title: Portuguese Chicken Skillet
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Portuguese-inspired chicken skillet recipe, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, tomato paste, chicken seasoning, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
